# ElementUI

The declarative UI library Element's screens are built with. Pinned from ElementUI `af975197ad98d789ce4056d5b32dd163bb9ad928` by `./scripts/run.sh elementui-sync <repository>`; don't edit these files by hand.

- `ElementUI.Core.dll`, `ElementUI.UGUI.dll`: shipped next to Element.dll in each version folder; other mods bind to them through Element.
- `analyzers/ElementUI.Analyzers.dll`: build-time rules (UI001…), not shipped.
